jobs.title: Product Manager (Senior / Staff)
jobs.description:
PermitFlow is redefining how America builds. We’re an applied AI company serving the nation’s builders, tackling one of the largest information challenges in the economy: understanding what can be built, where, and how. Our AI agent workforce helps the fastest-growing construction companies navigate everything from permitting and licensing to inspections and project closeouts – accelerating housing, clean-energy, and infrastructure development across the country.

Despite being a $1.6T industry, construction still suffers from massive delays, wasted capital, and lost opportunity. PermitFlow has already delivered unprecedented speed, accuracy, and visibility to over $20B in development, helping contractors reduce compliance time, de-risk projects, and scale with confidence.

As the U.S. enters a new capex supercycle across data centers, factories, housing, and renewables, joining PermitFlow means building the AI infrastructure at the core of every construction project driving the next wave of reindustrialization.

We’ve raised over $90M, most recently completing our Series B, https://www.permitflow.com/blog/permitflow-series-b from top-tier investors including Accel, Kleiner Perkins https://www.linkedin.com/feed/update/urn:li:activity:7401703305569275904/, Initialized, Y Combinator, Felicis, and Altos Ventures, with backing from leaders at OpenAI, Google, Procore, ServiceTitan, Zillow, PlanGrid, and Uber.




BUILDING THE AI INFRASTRUCTURE FOR CONSTRUCTION

 - Construction is one of the largest industries in the world - and one of the most operationally fragmented.

 - Before anything gets built, projects must move through permitting and pre-construction workflows spread across ~20,000 jurisdictions, each with different rules, systems, and processes.

 - The result is a massive bottleneck slowing down housing and infrastructure across the country.

 - PermitFlow is rebuilding this layer from the ground up - using modern software and AI systems to automate and orchestrate permitting end-to-end.

 - We are still early. The product surface area is expanding rapidly, the workflows are deeply complex, and the opportunity to shape how this industry operates is enormous.

 - This is one of those rare moments where product decisions directly influence how the physical world gets built.




LOCATION

 - Our HQ is in New York City with a hybrid schedule (3 in-office days per week). 




ROLE OVERVIEW

 - We’re hiring a Product Manager to lead critical product initiatives across PermitFlow’s platform.

 - This is a highly ownership-driven role at the intersection of AI, workflow automation, and real-world operational complexity. You’ll work directly with engineering, design, operations, leadership, and customers to define products that simplify one of the most fragmented workflows in the physical economy.

 - The best PMs here operate like builders and owners. They move quickly, prioritize ruthlessly, stay close to customers, and drive clarity in ambiguous environments.

 - You will own problems end-to-end from customer discovery and product strategy through execution, launch, iteration, and measurable customer impact.

 - This is not a role where you inherit a fully-defined roadmap. You’ll help define what gets built, why it matters, and how the product evolves as the company scales.




WHAT YOU’LL DO

 - Lead a core product area focused on customer-facing workflows and AI-powered systems that simplify complex permitting processes

 - Drive the full product lifecycle: discovery, prioritization, design, development, launch, and iteration

 - Work directly with customers to deeply understand pain points, operational bottlenecks, and workflow inefficiencies

 - Translate ambiguous real-world problems into intuitive, scalable product experiences

 - Partner closely with engineering, design, operations, and sales to deliver products that create measurable customer and business impact

 - Define product strategy, roadmap priorities, success metrics, and execution plans across teams

 - Drive alignment across leadership and cross-functional stakeholders in a fast-moving environment

 - Help establish product standards, operating principles, and execution culture as the PM organization scales




WHAT WE’RE LOOKING FOR

We’re looking for product leaders who thrive in high-ownership environments and enjoy solving operationally complex problems.

 - 3+ years of product management experience shipping impactful products in startups or fast-moving environments

 - Strong product judgment and ability to prioritize effectively across competing opportunities

 - Experience leading product initiatives with meaningful business or customer impact

 - Ability to operate effectively in ambiguity and create clarity for cross-functional teams

 - Excellent communication and collaboration skills across engineering, leadership, operations, and customers

 - Strong analytical and problem-solving ability with a customer-first mindset

 - Technical fluency and comfort working closely with engineering teams

 - High sense of ownership, urgency, and accountability

 - Bonus: experience with workflow systems, AI products, enterprise SaaS, or operational tooling




WHY THIS ROLE MATTERS

This is not a feature optimization role - it is a systems-building role inside a category being created in real time.

PermitFlow sits at the intersection of:

 - fragmented real-world regulatory infrastructure

 - high-friction operational workflows

 - and emerging AI systems capable of automating end-to-end complexity

The products built here directly impact how quickly housing and infrastructure projects move from idea to execution.

This role offers rare leverage: you’ll help define both the product experience and the operational foundation of a rapidly scaling company still early enough for individual decisions to meaningfully shape its trajectory.




WHAT WE OFFER

 - Competitive salary and meaningful equity in a high-growth company

 - 100% company-paid base medical, dental, and vision coverage for employees + healthcare FSA

 - 401(k) savings plan

 - Unlimited PTO and paid family leave

 - Home office & equipment stipend

 - Daily in-office lunch and dinner provided

 - Commuter benefits (pre-tax transit and parking)




CLOSING

If you’re excited by the opportunity to build AI-powered products that simplify complex real-world workflows - and want to help define a category from the ground up - we’d love to talk.



Inside PermitFlow: The Team Transforming Construction Permitting https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=Xbxs_TzlTTo



 

PermitFlow provides equal employment opportunities (EEO) to all employees and applicants for employment without regard to race, color, religion, sex, national origin, age, disability, genetics, sexual orientation, gender identity, gender expression, or family status, as protected by applicable law.


We are committed to a diverse and inclusive workforce and welcome people from all backgrounds, experiences, perspectives, and abilities. All employment decisions are based on merit, qualifications, and business needs.

LOCATION

 - Our HQ is in New York City with a hybrid schedule (Monday, Wednesday and Friday in-office). We prefer NYC-based candidates or those open to relocation.




ROLE OVERVIEW

 - We're hiring a Product Manager, AI to own PermitFlow's core AI infrastructure and workflow agents. This is a role that will require UX and technical acumen to deliver high quality agents in a genuinely complex domain, while also up-leveling our core agentic infrastructure and data flywheel. 

 - Submitting a permit means comprehending construction documents, extracting project details, confirming every requirement has been met and often filling in pdf forms. Errors compound across steps and a failed submission adds real cost for our customers as projects slow. 

 - In this context, you will be asked to deeply familiarize yourself with PermitFlow’s users, customers and use-cases, so you can develop a blended strategy, supporting single-shot full automation where possible and utilizing human-in-the-loop patterns where human judgment is still required. This is not an incremental role, we are looking for someone who can have a major impact in how fast construction gets done in America, Canada and beyond. 

 - The ideal candidate will mix an exceptional history of product delivery with true experience building AI and Agentic infrastructure from the ground up. You ship quickly, instrument everything, hold a high quality bar, and stay close to the users of what you build. 

 - This role reports directly to our Head of Product. We're hiring at Staff or Principal, with the level based on past experience and interview performance.




WHAT YOU’LL DO

You will operate across agent design, evaluation, and operational execution:

 - Deliver our core set of workflow agents for permitting, enabling rapid comprehension of construction projects and accurate compliance submissions for permits and inspections

 - Define what "reliable enough to submit" means at both the field and submission level, and own the quality bar that gates release

 - Own our path to full automation, segmenting use cases and driving to single-shot submission where accuracy allows

 - Design the architecture for assistive use cases, building the agents and tools that empower permit coordinators to move faster where humans-in-the-loop is the best solution

 - Work with our operations org to build an evaluation and data flywheel through early testing, golden data set generation, and structured error analysis ahead of submission

 - Build a durable design system around our data flywheel, ensuring that users can easily provide feedback on our Agents & AI products

 - Build the internal toolset for testing, error analysis, and hill climbing that every team at PermitFlow uses to ship agentic work

 - Serve as the internal applied AI expert for teams coming from more traditional software backgrounds




WHAT WE’RE LOOKING FOR

We're looking for product leaders who have shipped AI into production in domains where accuracy carries real-world consequences.

 - 7+ years of product management experience, or an equivalent track record in forward deployed engineering, applied research, or operations leadership

 - Direct ownership of the quality bar for a shipped AI/Agentic system

 - Hands-on experience building evaluations, including experience with golden data sets, LLM-as-judge, human annotation, and online monitoring

 - Judgment on when to build an agent and when a simpler product or process change delivers more

 - Deep technical fluency and comfortable engaging engineering on technical concepts

 - Track record of partnering closely with operations teams and translating operational insight into product

 - Ability to operate effectively in ambiguity and create clarity for cross-functional teams

 - High sense of ownership, urgency, and accountability

 - Track record of high quality delivery and increased scope across multiple roles




WHAT WE OFFER

 - Competitive salary and meaningful equity in a high-growth company

 - 100% company-paid base medical, dental, and vision coverage for employees + healthcare FSA

 - 401(k) savings plan

 - Unlimited PTO and paid family leave

 - Home office & equipment stipend

 - Daily in-office lunch and dinner provided

 - Commuter benefits (pre-tax transit and parking)




CLOSING

If you’re excited by the opportunity to build AI-powered products that simplify complex real-world workflows - and want to help define a category from the ground up - we’d love to talk.



Inside PermitFlow: The Team Transforming Construction Permitting https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=Xbxs_TzlTTo

You will evolve our Product Operations capabilities from a small team into a well-staffed, strategic organization that partners closely with Product, Engineering, Design, Operations, and the founding team to help the company execute more effectively.

 - You’ll be responsible for hiring and developing a team of Product Operations Managers, defining the company’s Product operating system and quality standards, and building the systems and processes that enable great product execution at scale.

 - This is a player-coach leadership role that requires exceptional operational judgment, strong product instincts, and the ability to operate both strategically and hands-on in a fast-paced startup environment.

 - Do hands-on Product Operations work yourself, particularly on the systems and programs that set the quality bar for the rest of the team.

 - Own and evolve the systems that support Product planning, execution, launches, and measurement to ensure consistency, scalability, and clarity as the company grows.

 - Establish consistent quality standards and review processes across the Product organization, ensuring teams have clear goals, requirements, success metrics, and launch plans.

 - Partner closely with leadership to improve Product execution in ways that directly impact business metrics, including activation, retention, customer satisfaction, and product velocity.

 - Set the vision for how AI transforms the Product Operations function, driving adoption of AI tools and evolving workflows across the team.

 


WHAT WE’RE LOOKING FOR

We’re open to calibrating the level of this role based on the candidate’s experience and scope of impact, from Manager through Head of Product Operations. We’re ultimately looking for the strongest product operations leader for the business, with title and scope matched to their track record and leadership experience.

 - 8+ years of experience in Product Operations, Business Operations, Strategy & Operations, or B2B SaaS product leadership. Experience supporting complex workflow products with data-heavy systems and cross-functional stakeholders.

 - 3+ years of experience leading and managing teams, ideally in a high-growth startup or technology company.

 - Proven experience building Product Operations teams and functions from early-stage to scale.

 - Exceptional operational judgment across planning, prioritization, product development, launches, measurement, and cross-functional execution. Systems thinking, not just strong project management.

 - Player-coach mentality with the ability to do hands-on Product Operations work while simultaneously building and scaling a team.

 - Active AI fluency, with AI tools integrated into your daily operating workflow. Strong opinions on how AI is changing the way Product Operations teams work and a track record of evolving your own process accordingly.

 - Strong experience standing up Product operating processes, including planning rituals, PRD quality standards, launch readiness, product reviews, customer feedback systems, and product metrics.
